title: DEA Makers Lightsaber Prototype
overview: Custom functional lightsaber replica developed with WPI MakerBucks support, focusing on prop design, hardware integration, and rapid prototyping.
scope: Custom hilt design, component integration, assembly, and allocation of funds for materials and 3D printing.
materials:
• Custom 3D-printed hilt components
 • Integrated electronic components (likely LED and/or sound elements, based on typical lightsaber-prop builds)
 • Fasteners and internal mounting hardware
fabricationSteps:
1. Design the hilt in CAD, planning internal space for electronics.
 2. 3D print the hilt components.
 3. Source and integrate the electronic hardware (lighting/sound, per design).
 4. Assemble the electronics into the printed hilt.
 5. Finish and detail the hilt's exterior.
 6. Test the completed prop and document with photos and video.
outcome: Successfully constructed a functional prototype with visual documentation and a video demonstration.
